gearcoleco.name: GearColeco
gearcoleco.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for ColecoVision. Requires colecovision.rom in RetroArch's system directory; coleco.rom is also accepted by the core.

cap32.name: Caprice32
cap32.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Amstrad GX4000 through the Caprice32 CPC/GX4000 core. Supports .cpr and .zip content. For GX4000 cartridges, set cap32_model = "6128+ (experimental)" and cap32_gfx_colors = "24bit". No BIOS required.

freechaf.name: FreeChaF
freechaf.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Fairchild Channel F. Requires sl31253.bin and sl31254.bin in the RetroArch system directory; sl90025.bin is an optional Channel F II PSU1 BIOS.

emuscv.name: EmuSCV
emuscv.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Epoch Super Cassette Vision. Supports .cart, .bin, .rom, split .0-.3 ROMs, and zipped ROMs.

mame_scv.name: MAME Current (Super Cassette Vision)
mame_scv.notes: Fallback RetroArch path for Epoch Super Cassette Vision via MAME software-list emulation. Requires scv.zip and scv.xml.

handy.name: Handy
handy.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Atari Lynx.

virtualjaguar.name: Virtual Jaguar
virtualjaguar.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Atari Jaguar.

mednafen_pce_fast.name: Beetle PCE Fast
mednafen_pce_fast.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for PC Engine/TurboGrafx-16 and PC Engine CD/TurboGrafx-CD. HuCard games do not require BIOS; CD games require syscard3.pce in the RetroArch system directory.

flycast.name: Flycast
flycast.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Sega Dreamcast.

picodrive.name: PicoDrive
picodrive.notes: Lightweight RetroArch fallback core for Sega PICO, 32X, and Mega Drive/Genesis.

mupen64plus_next.name: Mupen64Plus-Next
mupen64plus_next.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Nintendo 64 and Nintendo 64DD. Supports .n64, .v64, .z64, .ndd, .bin, and .u1. 64DD uses Mupen64plus/IPL.n64 firmware and may require RetroArch subsystem handling.

parallel_n64.name: ParaLLEl N64
parallel_n64.notes: Fallback RetroArch core for Nintendo 64 and 64DD, mainly useful when Mupen64Plus-Next is unavailable or a platform benefits from ParaLLEl behavior.

gearsystem.name: Gearsystem
gearsystem.notes: Recommended lightweight RetroArch core for SG-1000, Master System and Game Gear. BIOS files are optional for Game Gear.

genesis_plus_gx.name: Genesis Plus GX
genesis_plus_gx.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Mega Drive/Genesis, Sega CD, Game Gear, and SG-1000. BIOS files are optional except Sega CD.

NES / Famicom (Nestopia).name: Nestopia
NES / Famicom (Nestopia).notes: Nestopia is a cycle accurate emulator for the NES/Famicom. This is the libretro port of the Nestopia emulator, based on the de facto upstream Nestopia JG fork. The libretro port contains an additional overclocking feature.

mame.name: MAME Current
mame.notes: Required for Hartung Game Master/MESS software-list style emulation.

mame_gp32.name: MAME Current (GP32)
mame_gp32.notes: Recommended RetroArch path for GamePark GP32 via MAME software-list emulation. Requires gp32.zip and gp32.xml.

mame_supracan.name: MAME Current (Super Acan)
mame_supracan.notes: Recommended RetroArch path for Funtech Super Acan via MAME software-list emulation. Requires supracan.xml.

vecx.name: VecX
vecx.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for GCE Vectrex. Supports .bin and .vec and does not require BIOS.

mame_advision.name: MAME Current (Adventure Vision)
mame_advision.notes: Recommended RetroArch path for Entex Adventure Vision via MAME software-list emulation. Requires advision.zip and advision.xml.

amiarcadia.name: AmiArcadia
amiarcadia.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Emerson Arcadia 2001. Supports .bin/.tvc and does not require BIOS.

mame_arcadia.name: MAME Current (Arcadia 2001)
mame_arcadia.notes: Fallback RetroArch path for Emerson Arcadia 2001 via MAME software-list emulation. Requires arcadia.xml.

mednafen_supergrafx.name: Beetle SuperGrafx
mednafen_supergrafx.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for NEC PC Engine SuperGrafx. Libretro Beetle PCE Fast removes the SuperGrafx module; use Beetle SuperGrafx for SGX HuCards.

mednafen_pcfx.name: Beetle PC-FX
mednafen_pcfx.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for NEC PC-FX. Requires pcfx.rom in the RetroArch system directory.

fceumm.name: FCEUmm
fceumm.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Nintendo Family Computer Disk System and NES/Famicom. Requires disksys.rom for FDS.

nestopia.name: Nestopia
nestopia.notes: Accurate RetroArch core for NES/Famicom and Family Computer Disk System. Requires disksys.rom for FDS.

mame_pv1000.name: MAME Current (Casio PV-1000)
mame_pv1000.notes: Recommended RetroArch path for Casio PV-1000 via MAME software-list emulation. No BIOS required; requires pv1000.xml.

mame_casloopy.name: MAME Current (Casio Loopy)
mame_casloopy.notes: Recommended RetroArch path for Casio Loopy via MAME software-list emulation. Requires casloopy.zip and casloopy.xml.

mame_studio2.name: MAME Current (RCA Studio II)
mame_studio2.notes: Recommended RetroArch path for RCA Studio II via MAME software-list emulation. Requires studio2.zip and studio2.xml. Studio II games are monochrome and may boot to a corrupted-looking screen until the console receives Clear plus a keypad selection. RetroArch game focus must be enabled so MAME sees keyboard keypad input: Clear is F3; Keypad A 1-9 are Q/W/E/A/S/D/Z/X/C and Keypad A 0 is Left Alt.

mednafen_wswan.name: Beetle WonderSwan
mednafen_wswan.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Bandai WonderSwan and WonderSwan Color. No BIOS required.

genesis_plus_gx_pico.name: Genesis Plus GX (Sega PICO)
genesis_plus_gx_pico.notes: Recommended RetroArch core profile for Sega PICO. Uses genesis_plus_gx_libretro.so and does not require Sega CD or Master System BIOS files.

genesis_plus_gx_sms.name: Genesis Plus GX (Master System)
genesis_plus_gx_sms.notes: RetroArch fallback core profile for Sega Master System / Mark III. Uses genesis_plus_gx_libretro.so; Master System boot ROMs are optional.

mame_neogeo.name: MAME Current (Neo Geo)
mame_neogeo.notes: Recommended installed RetroArch path for SNK Neo Geo using MAME arcade ZIP sets. Requires neogeo.zip and zipped game sets kept intact.

fbneo_neogeo.name: FinalBurn Neo (Neo Geo)
fbneo_neogeo.notes: Preferred lightweight arcade path when fbneo_libretro.so is installed. Requires neogeo.zip and FBNeo-compatible zipped game sets.

mednafen_ngp.name: Beetle NeoPop
mednafen_ngp.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for SNK Neo Geo Pocket and Neo Geo Pocket Color. No BIOS required.

race.name: RACE
race.notes: Lightweight fallback RetroArch core for SNK Neo Geo Pocket/Color. No BIOS required.

neocd.name: NeoCD
neocd.notes: Recommended dedicated RetroArch core for SNK Neo Geo CD. Supports .cue and .chd; BIOS must be under system/neocd.

o2em.name: O2EM
o2em.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Magnavox Odyssey2 / Philips Videopac. Requires o2rom.bin in the RetroArch system directory.

gambatte.name: Gambatte
gambatte.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Nintendo Game Boy and Game Boy Color. Supports .gb, .gbc, and .dmg; gb_bios.bin is optional when official bootloader is enabled.

mgba.name: mGBA
mgba.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Nintendo Game Boy Advance; also supports Game Boy and Game Boy Color. gba_bios.bin is optional when the BIOS option is enabled.

dolphin.name: Dolphin
dolphin.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Nintendo GameCube and Wii. Supports .elf, .iso, .gcm, .dol, .tgc, .wbfs, .ciso, .gcz, .wad, .rvz, .wia, and .m3u. Requires dolphin-emu/Sys in RetroArch system directory for reliable operation.

melondsds.name: melonDS DS
melondsds.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Nintendo DS and DSi. Supports .nds, .ids, and .dsi. Plain DS cartridge mode can use FreeBIOS, but DSi mode and DSiWare require DS BIOS, DSi BIOS, firmware, and NAND files.

desmume.name: DeSmuME
desmume.notes: Fallback RetroArch core for Nintendo DS. Supports .nds, .ids, and .bin; optional external BIOS/firmware can be enabled through core options.

azahar.name: Azahar
azahar.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Nintendo 3DS. Supports .3ds, .3dsx, .z3dsx, .elf, .axf, .cci, .zcci, .cxi, .zcxi, and .app. Requires decrypted ROMs; some games require user-dumped Mii data.

citra.name: Citra
citra.notes: Fallback RetroArch core for Nintendo 3DS. Supports .3ds, .3dsx, .elf, .axf, .cci, .cxi, and .app. Requires decrypted ROMs; some games require user-dumped Mii data.

freeintv.name: FreeIntv
freeintv.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Mattel Intellivision. Supports .int, .bin, and .rom. Requires exec.bin and grom.bin in RetroArch system.

ardens.name: Ardens
ardens.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Arduboy and Arduboy FX. Supports .hex and .arduboy; no BIOS required.

arduous.name: Arduous
arduous.notes: Fallback RetroArch core for Arduboy. Supports .hex; no BIOS required.

mame_leapster.name: MAME Current (Leapster)
mame_leapster.notes: Recommended RetroArch path for LeapFrog Leapster via MAME software-list emulation. Current MAME marks the Leapster family MACHINE_NOT_WORKING and software entries unsupported, so this is tracked as backend-ready rather than runtime-validated.

gw.name: Handheld Electronic (GW)
gw.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Game & Watch-style handheld electronic .mgw simulators. No BIOS required. Libretro docs describe it as easier to get running than MAME for these games.

pokemini.name: PokeMini
pokemini.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Nintendo Pokemon Mini. Supports .min content. bios.min is optional because the core can use its embedded FreeBIOS fallback.

snes9x.name: Snes9x
snes9x.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Satellaview .bs content. Libretro core-info documents BS-X.bin in the system directory for BS-X/Satellaview.

snes9x_sufami_turbo.name: Snes9x (Sufami Turbo)
snes9x_sufami_turbo.notes: Recommended RetroArch core path for Sufami Turbo .st content. Uses snes9x_libretro.so and requires STBIOS.bin in the system directory.

bsnes.name: bsnes
bsnes.notes: Fallback high-accuracy RetroArch core for Satellaview and SNES. Requires BS-X.bin for Satellaview.

snes9x_snes.name: Snes9x (SNES)
snes9x_snes.notes: Recommended RetroArch core path for standard Super Nintendo Entertainment System content. Uses snes9x_libretro.so and does not require BIOS for normal cartridges.

bsnes_snes.name: bsnes (SNES)
bsnes_snes.notes: Fallback high-accuracy RetroArch core path for standard SNES content. Special-chip firmware may be needed for some edge cases, but normal cartridges do not require BIOS.

mednafen_vb.name: Beetle VB
mednafen_vb.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Nintendo Virtual Boy. Supports .vb, .vboy, and .bin; no BIOS required.

potator.name: Potator
potator.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Watara Supervision. Supports .bin and .sv content; no BIOS required.

mame_gamecom.name: MAME Current (Game.com)
mame_gamecom.notes: Recommended RetroArch path for Tiger Game.com via MAME software-list emulation. Requires gamecom.zip and gamecom.xml.

o2em_videopac_plus.name: O2EM (Videopac+)
o2em_videopac_plus.notes: Recommended RetroArch core path for Philips Videopac+ / G7400. Uses o2em_libretro.so and requires g7400.bin in the RetroArch system directory.

mame_crvision.name: MAME Current (CreatiVision)
mame_crvision.notes: Recommended RetroArch path for VTech CreatiVision via MAME software-list emulation. Requires crvision.zip and crvision.xml. Games commonly need F10 then R after boot.

mame_vsmile.name: MAME Current (V.Smile)
mame_vsmile.notes: Recommended RetroArch path for VTech V.Smile via MAME software-list emulation. Requires vsmile.zip and vsmile_cart.xml.

opera.name: Opera
opera.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for The 3DO Company - 3DO. Supports .iso, .bin, .cue, and .chd; panafz10.bin is the validation BIOS.

cemu.name: Cemu
cemu.notes: Experimental Libretro Cemu core for Nintendo Wii U. Supports .wud, .wux, .wua, .iso, .rpx, .elf, and .tmd; encrypted titles require system/Cemu/keys.txt and graphics require Vulkan or OpenGL 4.5.

swanstation.name: SwanStation
swanstation.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Sony - PlayStation. Supports .exe, .psexe, .cue, .bin, .img, .iso, .chd, .pbp, .ecm, .mds, .psf, and .m3u. Requires a valid BIOS such as scph5500.bin, scph5501.bin, and scph5502.bin for full region coverage.

puae.name: PUAE
puae.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Commodore CD32 and CDTV. Supports cue/bin, iso, chd, m3u, and compressed disc archives. Use console-specific model options and BIOS requirements for deterministic CD boot behavior.

ppsspp.name: PPSSPP
ppsspp.notes: Recommended RetroArch core for Sony PlayStation Portable. Supports .elf, .iso, .cso, .prx, .pbp, and .chd. No PSP BIOS is required, but PPSSPP core assets must exist under system/PPSSPP.

same_cdi.name: SAME CDi
same_cdi.notes: Recommended libretro path for Philips CD-i. Supports .chd, .iso, and .cue content; use CHD/CUE providers when possible. Requires cdimono1.zip under system/same_cdi/bios.

pcsx2.name: PCSX2 / LRPS2
pcsx2.notes: Preferred libretro path for Sony PlayStation 2 when BIOS dumps are available. Supports ELF, ISO, CISO, CUE/BIN, CHD, CSO, MDF/NRG/IMG, and M3U. Requires user-provided BIOS files under system/pcsx2/bios.

play.name: Play!
play.notes: BIOS-free PlayStation 2 fallback core with lower compatibility than PCSX2/LRPS2. Useful for homebrew smoke tests and machines where PCSX2 BIOS is not configured.

vita3k.name: Vita3K
vita3k.notes: External standalone emulator for Sony PlayStation Vita. Not a libretro core and not installed under RetroArch. Vita3K supports package/archive/folder installs; .pkg files require zRIF/license material. ROMs Manager stages Vita packages locally until automatic Vita3K import/launch is implemented. Backend APIs must not expose local Vita3K paths.
